ciFast.note: Fast verification will rerun formatting, lint, unit, evaluation, build, bundle, and release-history gates after push.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains a separate downstream workflow and is not represented as instructor or classroom evidence.

deploy.note: Production deployment remains downstream of successful repository checks and merge.

liveProvider.note: The post-deploy browser-local Scion generation, Agent, console, and physical ZIP audit will run on the production origin so the existing model cache can be reused.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, expert, human-preference, accessibility, classroom, or student-outcome claim is made.

manualBrowser.note: Desktop, phone-size, generation-progress, final workspace, Agent, and export frames will be inspected after deployment.

claims.summary: The free hosted path exposes one Scion model and migrates the retired experimental model id to the current Scion release.
Scion prepares source-consolidated evidence for unresolved lessons before browser-local inference without adding another public model download.
Optional evidence is admitted only with complete facts, concepts, trusted citations, and fully anchored provenance; malformed evidence cannot become source-backed content.
Instructor facts and specialized compiler knowledge retain priority, while accepted Scion evidence binds to the immutable numbered source ledger before authoring.
Scion current-source research remains off by default and the opt-in UI states the request boundary and public source order.
Verified or cached Scion evidence suppresses the duplicate legacy open-reading lookup and second research-progress sequence.
Active product surfaces use one Scion identity, the evidence forecast preserves common instructional acronyms, and blocked ZIP quality evidence agrees with its manifest and readiness report.
Automated gates verify compiler contracts and implementation integrity without implying a model-weight, adapter, human, or classroom quality victory.

carryForward.item: Run the production-origin browser-local Scion generation, Agent, console, and physical ZIP audit after deployment and record any required patch honestly.
Capture matched same-course Scion-with-evidence versus Scion-without-evidence packages before claiming a measured content-quality lift.
Keep the optional trained adapter inactive until it beats the pinned public base on the frozen held-out ruler.
Seek independent instructor or classroom evidence before raising the Automated Readiness evidence tier.
